notes: Intro: Coppergate provides discovery & retrieval for mid-size CROs and pharma R&D orgs across EU/UK.
Primary ask: low-latency enterprise search across 30-50M docs (protocols, CRFs, SAE reports) with reranking layer to surface regulatory-relevant passages.
Scale: expect initial index 5-10M docs in POC, planned production 40M+ docs. Approx 1.1B vectors at 1536 dims (vendor estimate).
Latency targets: p50 < 40ms vector lookup, p95 end-to-end (embed+search+rerank) < 120ms for EU region; acceptable failover penalty to UK region up to +80ms.
Throughput: baseline 150 QPS sustained, burst to 350 QPS; background embedding reindex window for nightly delta ingestion.
Cost sensitivity: target combined cost per query (embedding + vector lookup + rerank) < $0.015 with room to trade latency <-> cost via batching/quantization.
Security: strict residency requirement: customer data must remain in EU or UK (contract-level), SIEM/KMS integration required, SSO via SAML and audit logs retained 13 months.

Model preferences: open/quantized models preferred (customer legal disallows opaque hosted LLMs for PHI-like documents). Wants ability to pin model version and automatic fallback to smaller quantized variant for cost spikes.

Routing: need multi-region routing with sticky routing by user locale and automatic failover between eu-west-1 (Ireland) and eu-west-2 (London); prefer regional tie-breaker: residency > latency > cost.
Quote: CTO: 'We need search results that meet regulatory QA — precision matters more than flashy summaries. Reranker must be deterministic and explainable.'

POC ask: ingest 5M docs, demo reranked results with small test prompts, show p95 latency and cost per 1k queries. Acceptance = reranker improves MAP@10 by >= 12% vs baseline BM25 + vector pairwise score.
Procurement notes: procurement team requires DP Addendum and data flow diagrams. Legal has redlines around subprocessor list and UK data transfer language.
SE notes from deep-dive: must benchmark indexing time for 40M docs; prefer Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching and quantization thresholds.

technical_requirements: Indexing: production target 40M+ docs, incremental daily delta ~200k docs
Embeddings: 1536-dim vectors; batch embed pipeline with GPU offload for nightly reindex
QPS: sustained 150 QPS; peak 350 QPS; need autoscale headroom
Latency SLOs: vector lookup p50 < 40ms, vector lookup p95 < 90ms; rerank adds <40ms to p95 end-to-end in-region
Reranking: 2-stage (dense retrieval -> light re-ranker model on top); explainability needed for top-3 results
Storage: index retention 3 years on-hot for compliance, cold archive longer
Model hosting: prefer private VPC deployment or on-prem with Redwood control plane; ability to run quantized models on dedicated GPUs for cost
Failover: automatic cross-region failover with stateful cache warming and sticky routing by user locale
cost_targets: Annual budget target < $300k for first year of production; willing to purchase reserved capacity if ROI proven
Wants transparent token-level and per-route cost breakouts in console
model_preferences: open-source/quantized models (legal restriction on closed API calls)
ability to pin model versions + rollout policies
prefer small reranker (7B-class quantized) for latency/cost tradeoff
fallback chain: high-quality LLM -> smaller quantized reranker -> BM25 conditional fallback
routing_requirements: Regional sticky routing (users in UK served by eu-west-2 when possible)
Automatic failover to eu-west-1 with cache warming and KV prefix transfer
Routing policy prioritizes data residency, then latency, then cost
Observability: need per-region p95/p50, per-model cost panels and tracing for routing decisions
